description: Source code for the 'git daemon' service, implementing a network server for Git repositories with configuration, connection handling, and service management.

methods.name: logreport
methods.description: Logs messages to syslog, stderr, or ignores based on log destination.

methods.name: logerror
methods.description: Logs an error message.

methods.name: loginfo
methods.description: Logs an informational message if verbose is enabled.

methods.name: daemon_die
methods.description: Handles fatal errors by logging and exiting.

methods.name: path_ok
methods.description: Validates and constructs a repository path from a directory argument.

methods.name: run_access_hook
methods.description: Runs an external hook script for access control.

methods.name: run_service
methods.description: Executes a specified service for a repository after validation.

methods.name: copy_to_log
methods.description: Copies output from a file descriptor to the log.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to handle incoming protocol requests.

methods.name: addrcmp
methods.description: Compares two socket addresses.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles an incoming connection, dispatching to the appropriate service.

methods.name: child_handler
methods.description: Signal handler for child process termination.

methods.name: service_loop
methods.description: Main loop accepting and handling incoming connections.

methods.name: socksetup
methods.description: Sets up listening sockets based on configuration.

methods.name: setup_named_sock
methods.description: Creates and binds a socket for listening on a specific address and port.

methods.name: add_child
methods.description: Tracks a child process handling a connection.

methods.name: check_dead_children
methods.description: Reaps zombie child processes.

methods.name: kill_some_child
methods.description: Kills a duplicate connection if max connections are exceeded.

methods.name: parse_host_and_port
methods.description: Parses host and port from a string.

methods.name: sanitize_client
methods.description: Sanitizes client-supplied path components.

methods.name: canonicalize_client
methods.description: Sanitizes and lowercases client path components.

methods.name: lookup_hostname
methods.description: Resolves hostname to IP and canonical name.
